description.en: The basic client parameter that records information such as the SDK version number.

descriptions.zh:
上传文件到 OSS，可以先获取预签名的 URL，再进行 PUT。

PUT 操作等价的 curl 命令，可参照：
`curl -X PUT -H 'Content-Type:' --data-binary @/tmp/test.txt 'http://shuanglu-pre.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/13ba4081-84f3-42b0-af93-10a64319f8ef/test.txt?Expires=1604659193&OSSAccessKeyId=LTEI4FcsdDhFc7h78gqB****&Signature=+8lNqlW7ijIGLwNcyR****'`
descriptions.en:
To upload a file to OSS, you can first obtain a pre-signed URL and then perform a PUT request.

The following curl command is equivalent to the PUT operation:
`curl -X PUT -H 'Content-Type:' --data-binary @/tmp/test.txt 'http://shuanglu-pre.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/13ba4081-84f3-42b0-af93-10a64319f8ef/test.txt?Expires=1604659193&OSSAccessKeyId=LTEI4FcsdDhFc7h78gqB****&Signature=+8lNqlW7ijIGLwNcyR****'`.
